main_text.l: IOH. POLYANDRI MET. AD ECCLESIAM FRANCICAM iam penè seruam ELEGIA.
HALDÆVS quondam Rex quum sæuiret in vrbes Isacidùm, atque omnes depopularet agros:
Quúmque pij Iosiæ post funera, nullus ouili Qui Domini forti Marte præiret, erat:
Regibus ast victis vinctisque Israelis, in oras Aueheret ciues hostis & æra suas:
Ecce piis vdas lacrymis iustisque querelis, Ad dominum fudit quinque habuítque preces
Ieremias: populi culpam queis fleuit, & annos Quos septem decies exilium ipse tulit.
Quin etiam sanctum præeuntem Ecclesia vatem Prisca, fuit querulâ voce sequuta suum:
Persarum dùm Rege Cyro mandante, paternas Restituítque aras, restituítque focos.
Sic quoque mutatis Ecclesia Francica paucis, Prælia

page.notes: Running title and heading are printed at the top, centred; the heading is set in spaced capitals with a woodcut ornament above it. The final word "Prælia" stands at the right edge and is continued on a following page. Reading of the first line of the first stanza is approximate in places; the long-s forms have been normalised to s. Some letters in the first-line lacuna near the initial are doubtful.
